# BIM door: how an AI drives UNION

> How an AI drives UNION, a BIM and drafting program, for structural, mechanical, electrical and architectural offices through its MCP door: the guide, every command, the one-line ops and 449 real drafting jobs with their calls and UNION's answers, played on UNION 1.0.0-beta.2.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/bim-door/bim-door/blob/main/README.md): what UNION is and how an AI works in it
- [The guide](https://github.com/bim-door/bim-door/blob/main/guide/README.md): the work loop, the calls, fast ops, steps, recipes
- [Everything in one file](https://github.com/bim-door/bim-door/blob/main/llms-full.txt)

- [Commands](https://github.com/bim-door/bim-door/blob/main/commands/README.md): 499 commands with step lines, UNION's answers and options

## Examples
- [All examples](https://github.com/bim-door/bim-door/blob/main/examples/README.md): 449 jobs; [jobs.jsonl](https://github.com/bim-door/bim-door/blob/main/examples/jobs.jsonl)
- Setting out and structure: 64 jobs
- Architecture: 71 jobs
- Building services: 99 jobs
- Views, sheets and schedules: 76 jobs
- Annotation, details and materials: 67 jobs
- Change, modify and freeform: 72 jobs

UNION runs with a licence: free trial at https://www.unionbim.com/. Free research licences for AI labs, universities and researchers: research@unionbim.com.
